exercises.explanationUz:
TASHQI QIYOFA SO'ZLARI.

  Suratlardagi odamlar:
     A  Lee (25), Tokio, Yaponiya - manikyurchi
     B  William (47), Boston, AQSh - tadbirkor
     C  Bob (51), London, Angliya - bog'bon
     D  Pierre (38), Parij, Fransiya - gulfurush


⚠ YoSh HAQIDA GAPIRISh:

  'in his early fifties'
     = ellik-ellik uch yoshlarda
     (o'ninchi yillikning BOShI)

  'in his late forties'
     = qirq yetti-qirq to'qqiz yoshlarda
     (o'ninchi yillikning OXIRI)

  'in her mid-twenties'
     = yigirma besh yoshlarda
     (o'ninchi yillikning O'RTASI)

  ⚠ Qolip: in + egalik olmoshi +
     early / mid- / late + O'NLIK (ko'plikda)

  ⚠ O'nlik HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA:
     twentieS, thirtieS, fortieS, fiftieS


⚠ GAVDA SO'ZLARI:

  tall        - baland bo'yli
  short       - past bo'yli
  slim        - nozik
  of medium build - o'rtacha gavdali
  overweight  - vazni ortiqcha

  ⚠ 'fat' (semiz) QO'POL eshitiladi.
  Odob bilan 'overweight' deyiladi.

  ⚠ 'of medium build' - turg'un ibora.
  'build' bu yerda OT: gavda tuzilishi.


⚠ SOCh VA YUZ:

  going bald   - kal bo'lib borayotgan
  a beard      - soqol
  a moustache  - mo'ylov
  wrinkles     - ajinlar
  a complexion - yuz rangi, teri rangi
  full lips    - to'la lablar
  straight hair - tekis soch

  ⚠ 'a dark complexion' = qora tanli.
  ⚠ 'to go bald' - 'to be bald' emas:
  'go' JARAYoNNI bildiradi.


⚠ 'HE'S GOT' = 'HE HAS GOT'

  Britaniyada egalik 'have got' bilan:
     He's got a beard.
  AQShda: He has a beard.

tasks.prompt: 1  He's tall and overweight. He's going bald.
2  He is in his early fifties. He is tall and slim and has got a grey beard and a moustache.
3  He's got a dark complexion and a few wrinkles.

6  She is pretty, with full lips and a friendly smile.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  SA: Where is Lee from?

  SA: How old is she?
  SB: She's ...
  SA: What does she look like?

⚠ ENG MUHIM SAVOL:

  'What does she LOOK LIKE?'
     = U qanday KO'RINADI? (tashqi qiyofa)

  'What is she LIKE?'
     = U qanday ODAM? (xarakter)

  ⚠ Ikki savol BUTUNLAY BOShQA!
     look like → tall, slim, dark hair
     be like   → kind, friendly, funny


⚠ 'WHERE IS SHE FROM?'

  'from' HAR DOIM oxirida qoladi.
  ⚠ 'From where is she?' - noto'g'ri.


⚠ KASBNI AYTISh:

  'What's her job?' - 'She's A manicurist.'
  ⚠ Kasb oldidan 'a/an' ARTIKLI ShART!
  ⚠ 'She's manicurist' - XATO.

exercises.instructionEn: Describe each person as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  'Lee is from Tokyo, Japan. She's in her
   mid-twenties. She is slim, with long
   straight dark hair. She's pretty, with
   full lips and a friendly smile. She's a
   manicurist.'


QOLIP - BESh QADAM:

  1) ISM + is from + ShAHAR, MAMLAKAT
  2) He's/She's in his/her
     early/mid-/late + O'NLIK
  3) gavda + soch tasviri
  4) yuz tasviri
  5) He's/She's a + KASB


⚠ YoShNI AYTISh:

  25 → in her mid-twenties
  38 → in his late thirties
  47 → in his late forties
  51 → in his early fifties

  ⚠ 0-3 → early
     4-6 → mid-
     7-9 → late


⚠ 'WITH' BILAN QO'ShIMChA TAFSILOT:

  'She is slim, WITH long dark hair.'
  = U nozik, sochlari uzun va qora.

  ⚠ 'with' + tana qismi = ega bo'lish.

exercises.explanationUz:
HOZIRGI DAVOMLI ZAMON (present continuous).

  Qolip: am/is/are + fe'l + -ing

  ⚠ Bu zamon AYNAN HOZIR bo'layotgan
  ishni bildiradi - suratdagi ish.

  ⚠ Shuning uchun surat tasvirlashda
  DOIM shu zamon ishlatiladi.


⚠ -ING QO'ShIShNING QOIDALARI:

  carry  → carrying   (oddiy)
  polish → polishing  (oddiy)
  make   → making     (oxirgi 'e' TUShADI)
  talk   → talking    (oddiy)


⚠ 'SOMEBODY'S NAILS':

  'somebody' = kimdir
  "somebody's" = kimningdir (egalik)

  ⚠ Apostrof + s - EGALIK belgisi.


⚠ 'A BOUQUET OF FLOWERS':

  = guldasta.
  ⚠ Fransuzchadan kirgan: 'bu-KEY'
  deb o'qiladi, 't' O'QILMAYDI.


⚠ 'ON THE PHONE':

  'to talk ON the phone' - predlog 'on'.
  ⚠ 'in the phone' - XATO.

exercises.explanationUz:
TAXMIN QILISh MAShQI.

  ⚠ Bu mashqda javobni BILISh shart emas -
  suratlarga qarab TAXMIN qilinadi.
  To'g'ri javoblar 7-betdagi matndan
  ma'lum bo'ladi.

  ⚠ Bu 'predicting' deb ataladi va o'qish
  ko'nikmasining muhim qismi: matnni
  o'qishdan oldin nima haqida ekanini
  taxmin qilish.


SURATLAR (7-betda):
  E - plyajdagi uzun qayiqlar
  F - sholi dalasida ishlayotgan odamlar
  G - qizil fonda an'anaviy raqs
  H - qizil qalampirli taom
  I - somon shlyapali dehqon ayol
  J - daryoda qayiqda baliq ovlash
  K - futbol o'ynayotgan FIL
  L - buddaviylik ibodatxonasi


⚠ TAILAND HAQIDA:

  • Janubi-sharqiy Osiyoda, Xitoydan
    janubda
  • Aholining ko'pi QIShLOQLARDA yashaydi
  • Milliy taom - guruch, o'tkir ziravorlar
  • Buddaviylik mamlakati - ibodatxonalar
    ('temples')
  • Fil - milliy ramz


⚠ 'A TEMPLE' va 'A MOSQUE':

  a temple = ibodatxona (buddaviylik,
     hinduizm)
  a mosque = masjid (islom)
  a church = cherkov (nasroniylik)

  ⚠ Tailand - buddaviy mamlakat, shuning
  uchun 'temple'.

tasks.whyUz:
Tailand - Janubi-sharqiy OSIYoda, Xitoydan
janubda.

⚠ 'to be located in' = joylashgan.

7-betdagi matnda: 'They are SHORT with
delicate features.'

exercises.explanationUz:
TINGLASh MAShQI.

  ⚠ Kassetada 'Hello, People of Thailand!'
  maqolasi o'qiladi - ya'ni javoblar shu
  betdagi MATNDA ham bor.

  ⚠ Shuning uchun bu mashqni matnni o'qib
  ham bajarish mumkin.


⚠ T/F MAShQINING QOIDASI:

  Har gapni matndagi ANIQ gap bilan
  solishtiring. BITTA so'z farq qilsa ham
  javob F bo'ladi.

  ⚠ Eng ko'p uchraydigan tuzoq -
  ALMAShTIRILGAN SO'Z:
     matn: 'south-east ASIA'
     savol: 'south-east EUROPE'  → F


⚠ 'A JEWEL':

  = qimmatbaho tosh, javohir.
  ⚠ 'the jewel of south-east Asia' -
  ko'chma ma'no: eng go'zal joy.

NOTO'G'RI. Matnda: 'the jewel of south-east

exercises.explanationUz:
HAMMA IBORA 7-BETDAGI MATNDA BOR.

  ⚠ Bu - COLLOCATION mashqi: qaysi sifat
  qaysi ot bilan BIRGA yuradi.

  ⚠ Kirish betida (5-bet) aytilgan edi:
  'A particular feature of the book is the
  teaching of COLLOCATIONS.'


⚠ NIMA UChUN 'a(n)' FAQAT BA'ZILARIDA:

  1, 2, 5-bandlarda 'a(n)' bor -
  demak ot BIRLIKDA va SANALADIGAN.

  Qolganlarida artikl yo'q:
     • ko'plik (beaches, temples,
       features, people, wills, houses)
     • sanalmaydigan (history)

  ⚠ 'a' yoki 'an' - keyingi so'zning
  TOVUShIGA qarab:
     a rich culture      (r - undosh)
     an ancient temple   (a - unli)


⚠ HAR IBORANING MA'NOSI:

  a rich culture      - boy madaniyat
  a tropical climate  - tropik iqlim
  sandy beaches       - qumli plyajlar
  ancient temples     - qadimiy ibodatxonalar
  a holiday destination - ta'til manzili
  delicate features   - nozik yuz tuzilishi
  friendly people     - samimiy odamlar
  strong wills        - kuchli iroda
  wooden houses       - yog'och uylar
  cultural history    - madaniy tarix

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in: well known, typical, celebrate, generous, spicy, includes.
exercises.instructionUz: Qo'ying: well known, typical, celebrate, generous, spicy, includes.
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ZLARNI YANGI GAPDA QO'LLASh.

  ⚠ Hamma so'z 7-betdagi matnda bor edi,
  lekin bu yerda BOShQA mamlakatlar
  haqida gapiriladi. Bu - 'transfer':
  o'rganilgan so'zni yangi vaziyatda
  ishlatish.


⚠ MILLAT NOMLARI - 'THE' BILAN:

  The Japanese ARE ...
  The Spanish ...

  ⚠ 'the' + millat sifati = butun xalq.
  ⚠ Fe'l KO'PLIKDA bo'ladi ('are', 'like').

  ⚠ -ese va -sh bilan tugaydigan millatlar
  ko'plikda O'ZGARMAYDI:
     the Japanese, the Chinese,
     the Spanish, the British, the English

  ⚠ Boshqalari -s oladi:
     Indians, Americans, Italians
     (Bandlarda: 'Indian people' -
     'people' bilan ham aytish mumkin.)


⚠ QAYSI SO'Z QAYSI BANDGA:

  1  well known - 'be well known FOR'
     iborasi (11-mashqda ham bor)
  2  generous - xarakter sifati
  3  typical - 'odatiy'
  4  spicy - ovqat sifati
  5  includes - fe'l, 3-shaxs -S bilan
  6  celebrate - fe'l, 'the Spanish'
     ko'plik, shuning uchun -S YO'Q

  ⚠ 5 va 6-bandlarga DIQQAT:
     'The guidebook includeS' (birlik)
     'The Spanish celebrate' (ko'plik)

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct preposition, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri predlogni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLI IBORALAR.

  ⚠ Predlogni MANTIQ bilan topib bo'lmaydi -
  ular fe'l/sifat bilan BIRGA yodlanadi.

  ⚠ Hamma ibora 7-betdagi matnda bor edi.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  to have sth IN common
     = umumiy narsaga ega bo'lmoq
     'We have a lot in common.'

  to be proud OF sb/sth
     = ... dan faxrlanmoq
     'I am proud of my son.'

  to live IN a village
     = qishloqda yashamoq
     ⚠ 'in a village', 'in a city',
     lekin 'ON a farm', 'AT home'

  to consist OF sth
     = ... dan iborat bo'lmoq
     ⚠ 'consist' HECh QAChON continuous
     shaklda ishlatilmaydi.

  to be well known FOR sth
     = ... bilan mashhur bo'lmoq
     ⚠ 'for' PREDLOG, shuning uchun
     keyin -ING: 'well known for BEING
     generous'.


⚠ 'FOR' va 'AS' FARQI:

  well known FOR sth = nimasi bilan
     mashhur (sabab)
  known AS sth = qanday nom bilan
     tanilgan

  'He is well known FOR his songs.'
  'He is known AS the King of Pop.'

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'in common' - turg'un ibora.
'We have a lot IN common.'

⚠ 'proud OF' - HAR DOIM 'of'.
Matnda: 'proud of our history'.

⚠ 'IN a village/city/town'.
Lekin 'ON a farm', 'AT home'.

⚠ 'consist OF' - HAR DOIM 'of'.
⚠ Continuous shaklda ishlatilmaydi.

⚠ 'known FOR' = nimasi bilan mashhur.
⚠ 'known AS' = qanday nom bilan tanilgan.

exercises.instructionUz: Jadvaldan so'zlarni tanlang va sinfdoshlaringizni tasvirlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
TASHQI QIYOFA JADVALI.

  ⚠ Bu jadval butun unit davomida kerak
  bo'ladi - uni yaxshi yodlang.


⚠ TASVIRLASh TARTIBI (jadval tartibi):

  1) umumiy ko'rinish
  2) yosh
  3) bo'y
  4) gavda
  5) ko'z
  6) soch
  7) boshqa belgilar

  Namuna:
  'She is a pretty young woman. She is
   tall and slim with big green eyes and
   long curly fair hair. She has got a
   friendly smile.'


⚠ EHTIYoT BO'LING - QO'POL SO'ZLAR:

  ugly (xunuk), fat (semiz), plain
  (oddiy, chiroysiz) - bu so'zlar
  ODAMNI XAFA QILADI.

  ⚠ Odob bilan:
     fat  → a bit overweight, plump
     ugly → not very attractive


⚠ 'FAIR' va 'BLONDE':

  'fair hair' = oq-sariq soch
  'blonde' - asosan ayol uchun.


⚠ 'HEIGHT' va 'BUILD' FARQI:

  height = BO'Y (tall, short)
  build  = GAVDA (slim, well-built)

  ⚠ 'of medium height' = o'rtacha bo'yli
  ⚠ 'of medium build' = o'rtacha gavdali
  Ikkalasi ham 'of' bilan!

⚠ 'slim' - MAQTOV (nozik, kelishgan).
⚠ 'thin' - betaraf yoki salbiy (ozg'in).

'long curly fair hair'.

⚠ 'shoulders', 'lips', 'wrinkles', 'freckles' -

⚠ 'freckles' = sepkil (yuzdagi mayda dog'lar).

exercises.instructionEn: GAME: Choose one of your classmates. The rest of the class ask questions to find out who the person is, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: O'YIN: Sinfdoshlaringizdan birini tanlang. Sinfning qolgan qismi kim ekanini topish uchun savol beradi, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
TOPISH O'YINI - HA/YO'Q SAVOLLARI.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  S1: Is it a male?
  L:  Yes, he is.
  S2: Is he ...?
  L:  No, he isn't.
  S3: Has he got ...?
  L:  Yes, he has.
  S4: Is it ...?
  L:  Yes, you're right, it is ...

  ⚠ 'L' = Leader (o'yinni boshqaruvchi).


⚠ QISQA JAVOB QOLIPI:

  Savol 'Is ...?' bilan boshlansa →
     'Yes, he IS.' / 'No, he ISN'T.'

  Savol 'Has ... got?' bilan boshlansa →
     'Yes, he HAS.' / 'No, he HASN'T.'

  ⚠ Qisqa javobda SAVOLDAGI FE'L
  takrorlanadi - boshqa fe'l EMAS.

  ⚠ 'Yes, he is.' - to'liq shakl.
     'Yes, he's.' - XATO! Tasdiqda
     qisqartma ishlatilmaydi.


⚠ 'A MALE' va 'A FEMALE':

  a male   = erkak jinsi
  a female = ayol jinsi

  ⚠ Bu - RASMIY/ILMIY so'zlar
  (hujjatlarda, anketalarda).
  Oddiy nutqda 'a man' / 'a woman'.


⚠ 'IS IT' va 'IS HE':

  Boshida kim ekani NOMA'LUM →
     'IS IT a male?'
  Jinsi ma'lum bo'lgach →
     'IS HE tall?'

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ Qisqa javobda savoldagi fe'l ('is')
takrorlanadi.

⚠ Qisqa javobda savoldagi fe'l ('is')
takrorlanadi.

⚠ 'Has ... got?' → 'Yes, he HAS.'
'Yes, he has got' deyish ham mumkin, lekin
qisqasi tabiiyroq.

⚠ 'Has ... got?' → 'Yes, he HAS.'
'Yes, he has got' deyish ham mumkin, lekin
qisqasi tabiiyroq.

exercises.instructionUz: Sifatlarni sabablarga moslang, so'ng ular bilan yaxshi tanigan odamlaringizni tasvirlang, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
XARAKTER SIFATLARI.

  ⚠ Bu sifatlar 'What is he LIKE?'
  savoliga javob beradi (tashqi qiyofa
  emas!).

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Tom is very honest. He never tells lies.'

  ⚠ Qolip: ISM + is (very) + SIFAT.
     Keyin SABAB gapi.


⚠ IJOBIY VA SALBIY:

  IJOBIY:  honest, loyal, imaginative,
           sociable, talkative*
  SALBIY:  jealous, mean
  BETARAF: shy

  * 'talkative' vaziyatga qarab ijobiy
    ham, salbiy ham bo'lishi mumkin.


⚠ ADAShTIRMANG - 'MEAN':

  'mean' (sifat) = xasis, ziqna
  'mean' (fe'l) = anglatmoq

  ⚠ AQShda 'mean' = qo'pol, yomon.
  Britaniyada esa asosan XASIS.

  ⚠ Betdagi 15-mashq jadvalida 'mean'
  ikki marta uchraydi (blue va black).


⚠ 'SHY' va 'QUIET':

  shy = uyatchan (odamlardan tortinadi)
  quiet = kamgap (shunchaki ko'p
     gapirmaydi)


⚠ 'TO TELL A LIE' va 'TO SAY':

  'to tell a lie' = yolg'on gapirmoq
  ⚠ 'to say a lie' - XATO!

  'tell' bilan: tell a lie, tell the truth,
     tell a story, tell the time


⚠ 'TO BETRAY':

  = xiyonat qilmoq, sotmoq.
  'loyal' (sodiq) sifatining aksi.

exercises.instructionUz: Eshiting va rangga mos kelmaydigan sifatning ustiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
SEVIMLI RANG VA XARAKTER JADVALI.

  Jadval sarlavhasi: 'YOUR FAVOURITE
  COLOUR & YOUR CHARACTER'

  ⚠ Har rangda UChTA sifat berilgan,
  ulardan BITTASI ortiqcha. Qaysi biri
  ortiqchaligi FAQAT AUDIODA aytiladi.

  * ⚠ red: brave, energetic, happy - qaysi
    biri ortiqcha? (audiodan)
  * ⚠ blue: kind, calm, mean - qaysi biri
    ortiqcha? (audiodan)
  * ⚠ green: jealous, sociable, lazy - qaysi
    biri ortiqcha? (audiodan)
  * ⚠ black: mean, happy, dishonest - qaysi
    biri ortiqcha? (audiodan)
  * ⚠ purple: imaginative, loyal, shy - qaysi
    biri ortiqcha? (audiodan)
  * ⚠ yellow: funny, serious, warm-hearted -
    qaysi biri ortiqcha? (audiodan)
  * ⚠ white: honest, sociable, lazy - qaysi
    biri ortiqcha? (audiodan)


⚠ SIFATLARNING MA'NOSI:

  brave       - jasur
  energetic   - g'ayratli
  happy       - baxtli
  kind        - mehribon
  calm        - vazmin, xotirjam
  mean        - xasis
  jealous     - hasadgo'y
  sociable    - kirishimli
  lazy        - dangasa
  dishonest   - insofsiz
  imaginative - tasavvuri boy
  loyal       - sodiq
  shy         - uyatchan
  funny       - hazilkash
  serious     - jiddiy
  warm-hearted- ochiqko'ngil
  honest      - halol


⚠ INKOR QO'ShIMChASI 'DIS-':

  honest → dishonest (insofsiz)
  ⚠ Jadvalda ikkalasi ham bor:
  'honest' (white) va 'dishonest' (black).


⚠ 15b MAShQI (audiosiz ham bajariladi):

  'Ask your friend what his/her favourite
   colour is, then use the table on the
   left to talk about his/her character.'

  Namuna: 'Susan's favourite colour is ...
  which means she is probably ... and ... .'

  ⚠ 'which means' = bu shuni anglatadiki.
  ⚠ 'probably' = ehtimol - fikrni
  YUMShATADI (chunki bu shunchaki o'yin).
exercises.audioNoteUz: Qaysi sifat rangga MOS KELMASLIGI faqat audiodan eshitiladi - kitob bilan birga keladigan yozuv kerak.

exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLANING TO'LIQ MATNI VA TARJIMASI
bandlarda berilgan.


⚠ MATNNING TUZILIShI - BESh QISM:

  1) Kirish shior: hammamiz bir
     dunyoning odamlarimiz
  2) Mamlakat: qayerda, iqlimi, nimasi
     mashhur
  3) Odamlar: tashqi qiyofa va xarakter
  4) Turmush: qishloq, ish, oila, ovqat
  5) Bo'sh vaqt va yakun

  ⚠ Bu - 'article' (maqola) janrining
  odatiy tuzilishi. 11-betdagi yozish
  mashqida siz ham shunday maqola
  yozasiz.


⚠ MATNDA IKKI MARTA TIRNOQ IChIDA
GAP BOR:

  '...' says Kasem from Bangkok.
  '...' explains Kasem.

  ⚠ Bu - 'a quotation' (iqtibos).
  Maqolada haqiqiy odamning so'zi
  keltiriladi - matn ishonchli bo'ladi.


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR (8a mashqida
tushuntirish so'raladi):

  holiday destination = ta'til manzili
  delicate features   = nozik yuz
                        tuzilishi
  generous            = saxovatli
  kind                = mehribon
  strong wills        = kuchli iroda
  proud of            = ... dan faxrlanadi
  spicy               = o'tkir, ziravorli
  noodles             = ugra, lag'mon
  popular             = mashhur, ommabop
  traditional         = an'anaviy
  fascinating         = maftunkor

tasks.en: Hello, People of Thailand!
Whatever country we come from, whatever colour our skin is, we all have one thing in common: we are all people of the world.
tasks.uz: Qaysi mamlakatdan bo'lsak ham, terimizning rangi qanday bo'lsa ham, bizda bitta umumiy narsa bor: hammamiz dunyo odamlarimiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'whatever' = qanday bo'lmasin, har qanday.

⚠ 'to have sth in common' = umumiy narsaga
ega bo'lmoq. Turg'un ibora.

⚠ 'colour' - Britaniya imlosi (AQSh: 'color').

tasks.en: Thailand is a beautiful country with a rich culture, just south of China.
tasks.uz: Tailand - boy madaniyatga ega go'zal mamlakat, Xitoydan janubda.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'south of China' = Xitoydan janubda.
Predlog 'of' bilan.

⚠ 'rich' bu yerda 'boy' (pul emas, madaniyat).

tasks.en: People call it 'the jewel of south-east Asia' for a good reason.
tasks.uz: Odamlar uni bejiz 'janubi-sharqiy Osiyoning javohiri' deb atamaydi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a jewel' = javohir, qimmatbaho tosh.
⚠ 'for a good reason' = bejiz emas, asosli sabab bilan.

⚠ 'to call sth sth' - ikki to'ldiruvchi:
'call IT the jewel'.

tasks.en: Its tropical climate, white sandy beaches and ancient temples make it a perfect holiday destination.
tasks.uz: Tropik iqlimi, oq qumli plyajlari va qadimiy ibodatxonalari uni mukammal ta'til manziliga aylantiradi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'ITS' (apostrofsiz) = uning (egalik).
'IT'S' (apostrof bilan) = 'it is'.
Bu - eng ko'p xato qilinadigan juftlik.

⚠ 'a destination' = manzil, borish joyi.
⚠ 'ancient' = qadimiy.

tasks.en: What makes it really special, though, is its people.
tasks.uz: Uni haqiqatan ham alohida qiladigan narsa esa - uning xalqi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'though' gap oxirida = 'lekin, esa'.
Verguller bilan ajratiladi.

⚠ 'What makes it special IS ...' - bu
'cleft sentence': fikrni ta'kidlash qolipi.

tasks.en: Thai people are good-looking. They are short with delicate features.
tasks.uz: Tailandliklar chiroyli. Ular past bo'yli, nozik yuz tuzilishiga ega.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'good-looking' = chiroyli (erkak va ayol uchun
ham). DEFIS bilan yoziladi.

⚠ 'delicate' = nozik, mayin.
⚠ 'features' = yuz tuzilishi (ko'z, burun, og'iz).

tasks.en: They have got black hair, dark eyes and light brown skin.
tasks.uz: Ularning sochi qora, ko'zlari to'q rangli, terisi och jigarrang.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'have got' - Britaniya egaligi.
⚠ 'hair' va 'skin' - SANALMAYDIGAN otlar.

⚠ 'light brown' = och jigarrang;
'dark brown' = to'q jigarrang.

tasks.en: The Thais are friendly people who are well known for being generous and kind.
tasks.uz: Tailandliklar - saxovatli va mehribonligi bilan mashhur samimiy xalq.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'THE Thais' - millat nomi oldidan 'the'.
⚠ 'well known FOR' + -ING shakli.

⚠ 'generous' = saxovatli; 'kind' = mehribon.

tasks.en: "We are a happy people who have strong wills and are especially proud of our history," says Kasem from Bangkok.
tasks.uz: "Biz kuchli irodali va tariximizdan alohida faxrlanadigan baxtli xalqmiz", - deydi Bangkoklik Kasem.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a people' (artikl bilan) = XALQ, millat.
'people' (artiklsiz) = odamlar.

⚠ 'a will' = iroda.
⚠ 'proud OF' - predlog 'of'.

tasks.en: Most people in Thailand live in villages.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'most people' - artiklsiz.
⚠ 'THE most' faqat qiyoslashda: 'the most
beautiful'.

tasks.en: A typical Thai village consists of wooden houses, a school and a Buddhist temple.
tasks.uz: Odatiy tailand qishlog'i yog'och uylar, maktab va buddaviylik ibodatxonasidan iborat.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to consist OF' - predlog 'of' HAR DOIM.
⚠ 'wooden' = yog'ochdan ('wood' + -EN).
⚠ 'Buddhist' - katta harf bilan (din nomi).

tasks.en: The men usually work in the fields or catch fish in the rivers, and the women plant the crops.
tasks.uz: Erkaklar odatda dalada ishlaydi yoki daryolarda baliq ovlaydi, ayollar esa ekin ekadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ PRESENT SIMPLE - odat, doimiy ish.
⚠ 'usually' - takrorlanish ravishi, asosiy
fe'ldan OLDIN turadi.

tasks.en: Family life is very important in Thailand, and families often eat together.
tasks.uz: Tailandda oila hayoti juda muhim va oilalar ko'pincha birga ovqatlanadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'often' - takrorlanish ravishi, asosiy
fe'ldan OLDIN: 'often EAT'.

⚠ 7-mashqning 4-gapida aynan shu jumla
inkor qilingan edi → javob F.

tasks.en: Thai food is very spicy and includes curries, fish, seafood, soups and noodles.
tasks.uz: Tailand taomi juda o'tkir bo'lib, karri, baliq, dengiz mahsulotlari, sho'rvalar va ugrani o'z ichiga oladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'spicy' = o'tkir, ziravorli ('a spice' = ziravor).
⚠ 'noodles' - HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA.
⚠ 'to include' = o'z ichiga olmoq.

tasks.en: "We eat rice with our meals and use a lot of strong spices in our cooking," explains Kasem.
tasks.uz: "Biz ovqatimiz bilan guruch yeymiz va pishirishda ko'p o'tkir ziravor ishlatamiz", - tushuntiradi Kasem.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a meal' = ovqatlanish mahali (nonushta,
tushlik, kechki ovqat).
⚠ 'a lot of' - sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan
otlar bilan ham ishlatiladi.

tasks.en: Thai people love to enjoy themselves. Popular free-time activities include Thai boxing and watching traditional dance shows.
tasks.uz: Tailandliklar ko'ngil ochishni yaxshi ko'radi. Ommabop bo'sh vaqt mashg'ulotlari - tailand boksi va an'anaviy raqs tomoshalarini ko'rish.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to enjoy ONESELF' = ko'ngil ochmoq.
O'zlik olmoshi ShART.

⚠ 'free-time' - defis bilan, chunki sifat
vazifasida.

tasks.en: Thais also celebrate many festivals throughout the year.
tasks.uz: Tailandliklar yil davomida ko'plab bayramlarni ham nishonlaydi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'throughout the year' = yil davomida.
⚠ 'to celebrate' = nishonlamoq.

tasks.en: "My favourite holiday is Surin, in November, when we always have elephant football matches," says Kasem.
tasks.uz: "Sevimli bayramim - noyabrdagi Surin, unda biz doim fil futboli musobaqalarini o'tkazamiz", - deydi Kasem.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'favourite' - Britaniya imlosi (AQSh:
'favorite').
⚠ 'in November' - oy oldidan 'in'.

⚠ K suratidagi fil futboli aynan shu.

tasks.en: Thailand is a wonderful country. Its fascinating sights, rich cultural history and warm-hearted people make it unique.
tasks.uz: Tailand - ajoyib mamlakat. Uning maftunkor manzaralari, boy madaniy tarixi va ochiqko'ngil odamlari uni betakror qiladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'fascinating' = maftunkor.
⚠ 'a sight' = ko'rgazmali joy, manzara.
⚠ 'warm-hearted' = ochiqko'ngil (warm + heart).
⚠ 'unique' = betakror, yagona.

     = qanday ODAM (xarakter)
     → friendly, generous, kind

  ⚠ Matnda ikkalasi ham bor va mashqda

  ataylab, farqni ko'rsatish uchun.


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR:

  delicate features - nozik yuz tuzilishi
  generous - saxovatli
  kind - mehribon
  strong wills - kuchli iroda
  proud of - ... dan faxrlanadi
  spicy - o'tkir, ziravorli

exercises.explanationUz:
QAYD OLIB GAPIRISh.

  ⚠ Bu usul 'note-taking' deb ataladi.
  Matnni yodlash EMAS - kalit so'zlarni
  yozib, ularga qarab O'Z GAPINGIZ bilan
  aytish.

  yodlangan gap emas, O'ZI TUZGAN gap

OLTI SARLAVHA VA MATNDAGI JAVOBLAR
bandlarda berilgan.


⚠ 'A DWELLING':

  = turar joy, yashash joyi.
  ⚠ Rasmiy so'z ('to dwell' = yashamoq).
  Oddiy nutqda 'a home' yoki 'a house'.


⚠ 'FREE-TIME ACTIVITIES':

  = bo'sh vaqt mashg'ulotlari.
  ⚠ 'free time' (ot) - AJRATIB.
  ⚠ 'free-time activities' (sifat) -
  DEFIS bilan.


⚠ QAYDNI QANDAY OLISh:

     Place: SE Asia, south of China
     People: short, delicate features

  ⚠ Qayd qancha qisqa bo'lsa, gapirganda

exercises.instructionEn: How many people are there in your family? What does each person look like? What is each person like?
exercises.instructionUz: Oilangizda necha kishi bor? Har bir odam qanday ko'rinadi? Har biri qanday odam?
exercises.explanationUz:
O'Z OILANGIZ HAQIDA GAPIRISh.

  ⚠ Bu betdagi HAMMA so'z shu yerda
  ishlatiladi: 12-mashq jadvali (tashqi
  qiyofa) va 14-mashq sifatlari (xarakter).


⚠ UChTA SAVOL - UChTA BOShQA JAVOB:

  'How many people are there in your
   family?'
     → 'There are five people in my family.'

  'What does he look like?'  (TAShQI)
     → 'He is tall and well-built with
        short dark hair.'

  'What is he like?'  (XARAKTER)
     → 'He is kind and very generous.'

  ⚠ Ikkinchi va uchinchi savolni
  ADAShTIRMANG - bu eng ko'p qilinadigan
  xato.


⚠ 'THERE ARE ... PEOPLE':

  'people' - KO'PLIK ot, shuning uchun
  'there ARE' ('there is' EMAS).

  ⚠ 'How many' + KO'PLIK ot.
  ⚠ 'How much' + sanalmaydigan ot.


⚠ OILA A'ZOLARI:

  parents   - ota-ona
  a father  - ota
  a mother  - ona
  a brother - aka/uka
  a sister  - opa/singil
  a son     - o'g'il
  a daughter- qiz
  grandparents - buvi-bobo

  ⚠ Inglizchada aka va uka BIR XIL
  ('a brother'). Farqlash uchun:
  'my older brother' / 'my younger
  brother'.

wordFormation.explanationUz: Betdagi to'rt kasb - to'rt xil qo'shimcha.
'He's going bald' shu qoidadan: 'go' o'zgarish JARAYoNINI bildiradi.
Ikki so'z defis bilan birikib bitta sifat hosil qiladi. Matnda uchtasi bor.
Matnda 'Its tropical climate' va 'Its fascinating sights' - ikkalasi ham EGALIK.

sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Shahar AVVAL, mamlakat KEYIN - vergul bilan.
⚠ 'from' bilan kelib chiqish aytiladi.

⚠ 0-3 → early, 4-6 → mid-, 7-9 → late.
⚠ O'nlik HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA: twentieS, fiftieS.

sentencePatterns.formula: What does he/she look like? - He's/She's [tashqi qiyofa].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What does she look like? - She's slim with long dark hair.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U qanday ko'rinadi? - U nozik, uzun qora sochli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'look like' = TAShQI qiyofa.
⚠ 'be like' = XARAKTER. Adashtirmang!

⚠ Kasb oldidan 'a/an' ARTIKLI ShART.
⚠ 'She's manicurist' - XATO.

⚠ PRESENT CONTINUOUS - aynan hozir bo'layotgan ish.
⚠ Suratni tasvirlashda DOIM shu zamon.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Thailand is a beautiful country with a rich culture.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tailand - boy madaniyatga ega go'zal mamlakat.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'with' + xususiyat - qisqa va chiroyli qolip.
⚠ 11-betdagi yozish mashqida kerak bo'ladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: People call it 'the jewel of south-east Asia'.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Odamlar uni 'janubi-sharqiy Osiyoning javohiri' deb ataydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to call sth sth' - ikki to'ldiruvchi, predlogsiz.
⚠ 'call it AS the jewel' - XATO.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They are short with delicate features.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular past bo'yli, nozik yuz tuzilishiga ega.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A typical Thai village consists of wooden houses and a school.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Odatiy tailand qishlog'i yog'och uylar va maktabdan iborat.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They are well known for being generous.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'for' PREDLOG, shuning uchun keyin -ING shakli:
'for BEING', 'for HELPING'.

sentencePatterns.formula: What does he/she look like? - He/She is [bo'y] and [gavda] with [soch/ko'z].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What does he look like? - He is tall and slim with short dark hair.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U qanday ko'rinadi? - U baland bo'yli va nozik, sochi kalta va qora.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ TAShQI QIYoFA savoli.
⚠ 'with' bilan soch va ko'z qo'shiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: What is he/she like? - He/She is [xarakter sifati].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What is he like? - He is honest and generous.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U qanday odam? - U halol va saxovatli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ XARAKTER savoli. 'look' YO'Q!
⚠ Bu ikki savolni adashtirish - eng ko'p
qilinadigan xato.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Tom is very honest. He never tells lies.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tom juda halol. U hech qachon yolg'on gapirmaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 14-mashqning namunasi: SIFAT + SABAB.
⚠ 'to TELL a lie' - 'to say' EMAS.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The Japanese are well known for their hospitality.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'the' + millat = butun xalq, fe'l KO'PLIKDA.
⚠ 'known FOR' - predlog 'for'.

sentencePatterns.formula: Has he/she got [nima]? - Yes, he/she has. / No, he/she hasn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Has he got a beard? - Yes, he has.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Qisqa javobda savoldagi FE'L takrorlanadi.
⚠ Tasdiq javobda qisqartma ishlatilmaydi.
